svg.title: Callout Studio settings
svg.desc: The settings window with Idea, Meeting, and Research above Obsidian's built-in callouts. Transparent background; no surrounding workspace.

text.font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

g.title: All your callouts. One creative space.
g.desc: The production settings list shows Idea, Meeting, and Research with two IDs each above all thirteen expanded built-in callouts, with their actual color swatches and editing controls.
